meta.title: Etsy SEO Strategy Guide 2026
meta.note: Dylan Jahraus course (courses.dylanjahraus.com) and YouTube channel are behind login/bot-block walls. Data compiled from Dylan's public blog, public SEO guides, and Etsy's official seller handbook.

dylan_jahraus_specific_strategies.background: Dylan Jahraus is a $1.8M+ Etsy seller whose shop ranks in the top 0.1% worldwide, reaching $1M+ in sales in 5 years.
dylan_jahraus_specific_strategies.core_philosophy: Show up in as many search results as possible using as many unique long-tail keywords as possible — prioritise functional SEO over pretty titles.

key_strategies.name: Customer-Centric Title Approach
key_strategies.description: The #1 SEO mistake is writing titles that describe the product itself rather than its purpose or utility for the customer. Shoppers search for solutions, not specs.
key_strategies.example: Bad: 'Blue Ceramic Mug 12oz' | Good: 'Gift for Coffee Lover, Funny Morning Mug, Housewarming Gift for Her'

key_strategies.name: General-to-Specific Keyword Order
key_strategies.description: Customers search general to specific (e.g. 'wedding dress boho lace'). Lead with nouns, follow with descriptive keywords. Match the natural search order buyers use.
key_strategies.example: Start with 'Personalized Leather Wallet' not 'Wallet Leather Personalized Engraved'

key_strategies.name: Unique SEO Per Listing
key_strategies.description: Every listing must have completely unique SEO. Never copy-paste the same title across listings — it limits you to one set of search terms for every product.
key_strategies.action: Write distinct long-tail keyword combinations for each individual listing

key_strategies.name: Mine Etsy Stats for Hidden Keywords
key_strategies.description: Go to Shop Manager → Stats → sort listings by revenue → click high-earning products → scroll to 'Search Terms'. Look for terms that generated 20+ visits but are NOT currently in your title/tags. These are high-intent, converting phrases to add immediately.
key_strategies.action: Check stats weekly and update listings with newly discovered converting search terms

key_strategies.name: Never Change a Bestseller's SEO
key_strategies.description: Do not edit the title or tags of a top-performing listing. Duplicate it first, test new keywords on the copy, then decide whether to swap.
key_strategies.action: Duplicate listing → test SEO → monitor for 2–4 weeks before applying to original

key_strategies.name: 3 Daily Listing Hacks
key_strategies.description: Dylan recommends a daily routine: (1) Refresh a listing's first photo, (2) update one listing's title with a newly discovered long-tail keyword, (3) add or renew a listing to trigger recency boost.
key_strategies.action: Spend 15–30 minutes daily on these three actions

key_strategies.name: Organic Growth Without Ads
key_strategies.description: Dylan generates $50,000+/month organically. The lever is SEO breadth — covering hundreds of long-tail search phrases across many listings rather than running paid ads on a few listings.

listing_title.recommended_characters: 70 or under (Etsy now soft-caps at 70 — exceeding this may be flagged as keyword stuffed)

description.critical_zone: first 160 characters (used as meta description in Etsy and Google search results)

rules: Put your single most important keyword phrase in the FIRST 30–40 characters
Use natural, conversational language — write how buyers actually search
Use long-tail phrases (3–5 words) not single generic words
Separate distinct keyword phrases with commas for readability and algorithmic clarity
Do NOT repeat the same keyword multiple times (keyword stuffing penalised since 2025–2026 update)
Keep total length to 70 characters or fewer if possible
Match the natural search order: general noun first, then descriptors
Include at least one occasion or use-case phrase (e.g. 'Gift for Mom', 'Birthday Gift', 'Office Decor')
dos: Front-load primary keyword: 'Macrame Wall Hanging – Boho Home Decor – Nursery Gift'
Use buyer language: 'pretty rings for mom birthday' not 'artisan floral silver band'
Include material, size, or style when relevant: 'Sterling Silver', 'Large', 'Minimalist'
Include gifting occasion when applicable: 'Housewarming Gift', 'Wedding Gift', 'Teacher Gift'
donts: Do NOT start with brand name or shop name
Do NOT stuff random keywords: 'Mug Cup Coffee Tea Drink Gift Women Men Birthday'
Do NOT repeat the same word twice in the title
Do NOT put your best keyword in the middle or end of the title
Do NOT write titles only from the product spec perspective

real_examples.good: Personalized Leather Wallet, Engraved Gift for Men, Anniversary Gift for Husband
real_examples.bad: Wallet Leather Personalized Brown Custom Engraved Men's Bifold Slim Card Holder

real_examples.good: Minimalist Gold Necklace for Everyday Wear, Dainty Layering Necklace, Gift for Her
real_examples.bad: Necklace Gold Minimalist Dainty Layering Jewelry Women Girls Ladies Chain

real_examples.good: Macrame Wall Hanging, Boho Home Decor, Large Woven Wall Art for Living Room
real_examples.bad: Wall Hanging Macrame Art Boho Woven Home Decor Large Bedroom Living Room

rules: Always use ALL 13 tag slots — unused slots are lost search surface
Each tag must be a multi-word phrase (2–4 words) — single-word tags are too broad to rank for
Do NOT repeat a phrase already in your title — Etsy already indexes titles
Do NOT repeat a phrase covered by your chosen category or attributes
Do NOT use the same root keyword in multiple tags unless paired with very different modifiers
Use synonyms and variations: if title says 'necklace', tags can include 'pendant', 'choker', 'chain necklace'
Include occasion-based tags: 'birthday gift', 'anniversary present', 'housewarming gift', 'mothers day gift'
Include recipient-based tags: 'gift for her', 'gift for mom', 'gift for boyfriend'
Include style-based tags: 'boho style', 'minimalist aesthetic', 'cottagecore decor'
Mix broad and specific: some broad category tags + several specific long-tail tags
tag_categories_to_cover: Product type / what it is (if not in title exact form)

strategy.broad_vs_specific: Mix 3–4 broader category tags with 8–10 specific long-tail tags. Broad = traffic entry; specific = conversion intent.

descriptions.seo_role: Etsy has confirmed listing descriptions are NOT indexed for Etsy search ranking. Their primary job is to convert a buyer who already clicked — not to rank.
descriptions.google_seo_role: Descriptions ARE indexed by Google. Include natural keyword usage to capture Google Shopping and organic search traffic.

structure.characters_1_to_160: Hook — most compelling benefit or feature. This is your meta description on both Etsy and Google. Make it specific and enticing.
structure.characters_161_to_500: Product details: materials, dimensions, colors available, customization options
structure.characters_500_to_1000: How to use it, who it's for, gifting context
structure.characters_1000_plus: Care instructions, processing/shipping time, shop policies, FAQ, keywords woven in naturally

rules: Write the first 160 characters as if it's an ad — it shows in search previews
Do NOT open with your shop name or 'Welcome to my shop'
Use secondary and long-tail keywords naturally throughout — don't force them
Answer the top 3 buyer objections before they ask
Include dimensions, materials, and customization details clearly
Mention gifting potential with specific occasions
Include processing time and shipping estimate
Write for humans first, keywords second
descriptions.example_opening_160_chars: Personalized leather wallet hand-stamped with any name or date — the perfect groomsmen gift, Father's Day gift, or anniversary present for him.
dos: Front-load your most important product benefit
Use bullet points for specs for easy scanning
Mention the item name + primary keyword in the first sentence
Include occasion keywords naturally: 'perfect birthday gift for dog lovers'
donts: Don't start with 'Welcome' or your shop name
Don't keyword-stuff — it reads poorly and doesn't help ranking
Don't leave the first 160 characters generic or vague
Don't write a wall of text with no line breaks

free_methods.description: Type your product keyword into Etsy search and note every autocomplete suggestion — these are real recent buyer searches.
free_methods.tip: Try typing each letter of the alphabet after your keyword to surface more suggestions

free_methods.description: In Shop Manager → Stats, click each listing and view 'Search Terms' — reveals exact phrases buyers used to find you.
free_methods.tip: Dylan Jahraus method: find terms with 20+ visits not yet in your title/tags and add them immediately

free_methods.description: Use Google Trends to find rising product and gift trends before they peak, then validate with Etsy tools.
free_methods.tip: Filter by 'Shopping' category for Etsy-relevant trend data

free_methods.description: Study top-ranking competitor listings in your niche — note their title structure, tag choices, and attribute selections.

paid_tools.pricing: Free plan (200 keyword lookups/day), Basic $5.99/mo, Pro $9.99/mo, Expert $29.99/mo
paid_tools.best_for: Listing audits, keyword competition scoring, trend tracking, identifying missing tags
Keyword brainstorming with 'Storm' tool, volume tracking, competition visualization
Largest database of Etsy products, competitor analysis, market gap identification, keyword competition level

stage_1_relevancy_matching.description: Etsy scans your listing to decide if it matches the search query
signals: Listing title (highest weight, especially first 40 chars)
Description (light context, not a primary signal)

stage_2_quality_ranking.description: Among matched listings, Etsy ranks by predicted likelihood to convert

signals.description: Based on clicks, favorites, dwell time, and purchases from search
Higher conversion rate = higher ranking. Good CTR is 2–5%; top listings hit 8–10%+
February 2026 update made shipping a direct ranking factor. Free shipping to US gets a measurable boost. High shipping costs penalise ranking.
How long a buyer stays on your listing page after clicking. Longer dwell time signals high-quality, relevant content.
Determined by your first photo and title. Higher CTR from search boosts ranking.
Reviews rating, response rate, shipping time accuracy. Poor shop scores suppress listing rankings.
Newly listed or renewed listings get a temporary recency boost. Use renewals strategically.
Listings with video get a small but measurable ranking uplift, especially in categories where video is uncommon.

semantic_search_2025_2026.description: Etsy's algorithm now matches buyer intent even without exact keyword matches. A search for 'pretty rings for mom birthday' may surface listings tagged 'mother birthday jewelry' or 'floral ring gift mom'.
semantic_search_2025_2026.implication: Natural, intent-based language in titles and tags now outperforms exact keyword stuffing.

first_photo_rules: High-contrast, scroll-stopping image — determines CTR from search
Show the product clearly and immediately — no ambiguity
Include at least one lifestyle photo showing product in real-world use
White or clean background for main photo in most categories
Use keyword-relevant image file names before uploading (e.g. 'personalized-leather-wallet-gift-for-men.jpg')

video.recommendation: Add a 15-second video showing product in use
video.impact: Small but measurable ranking uplift in 2026, especially in competitive categories where most sellers don't have video
video.tip: Even a simple phone video of the product from multiple angles or showing personalisation process is sufficient

photos_and_media.total_photos: Use all 10 photo slots. Etsy favours fully completed listings.

rules: Select the most specific subcategory available — don't stop at a top-level category
Fill out every relevant attribute field (color, size, material, occasion, style)
Attribute selections act as additional relevancy signals (like extra tags)
Correct category unlocks more attribute options — choose carefully
Do NOT add a tag that duplicates an attribute you've already selected
attributes_and_categories.impact: Filling all attributes can add 5–10 additional relevancy signals equivalent to extra tags.

common_mistakes_to_avoid: Copying the same title/tags across multiple listings
Putting primary keyword in the middle or end of the title
Keyword stuffing (now penalised by Etsy's 2025–2026 algorithm)
Ignoring Etsy Stats search term data
Editing a top-performing listing's SEO directly (duplicate and test instead)
Starting description with 'Welcome to my shop'
High shipping costs (now a direct ranking penalty since Feb 2026)
Using the exact same phrase in both title and tags
Targeting only high-competition broad keywords instead of long-tail phrases

for_new_listings: Research 3–5 long-tail keyword phrases using Etsy autocomplete + eRank
Write title: primary keyword first (first 40 chars), then 2–3 descriptors/occasions
Select specific category and fill ALL attribute fields
Write 13 unique multi-word tags covering synonyms, occasions, recipients, styles
Write first 160 chars of description as a compelling hook
Use all 10 photo slots; add video if possible
Offer free shipping if margins allow
for_existing_listings: Open Etsy Stats → check Search Terms for each listing
Find terms with 20+ visits not in current title/tags — add immediately
Audit tags: remove single-word tags, remove duplicates of title/categories
Update first photo to maximise CTR
For bestsellers: duplicate first, test on copy, never edit original directly
daily_routine_dylan_jahraus: Refresh first photo on one listing
Update one listing title with newly discovered long-tail keyword
Renew or add one listing for recency boost
